mode_entry: Explicit begin from current immutable owner revision; read-only supported design only. Detached mock map seeded from declared safe props or neutral values; no content write. Consumer is bound to actual window instance/preview UUID.
supported_schema: H2 supports Form/Button/CheckBox/TextBox/NumberInput/ComboBox only for mock capability. Button props permitted activation only. ComboBox items must be array of closed {id:string,label:string}, unique nonempty IDs; absent/unsupported items -> UnsupportedAction, not labels-as-identity. Scope must be absent or ui; unknown/non-ui scope disables mock capabilities without changing source. uiExclusive is data, never grants authority.

matrix.effect: set detached text, render via textContent
C1 exact numeric guard, set detached canonical numeric value; never JS float proof
only declared stable item ID from immutable supported items schema

sequence: Start expected_seq=1, increment checked once only on accepted mock action. Reject wrong/stale/invalid payload without consuming sequence. u64 max cannot be incremented -> SequenceOverflow and close preview, no partial update. Accepted action replay with old seq -> SequenceConflict; no second effect.
payload_rules: Action determines exact oneOf payload variant: Activate {},SetToggle checked,SetText text,SetNumber number_text,SelectItem item_id. Reject extra fields, mismatch, arbitrary command/eval/url/file/target paths.
permissions: Viewer capability allows only binding_get, viewer_begin/intent/refresh/close; never candidate/edit/undo/save/transfer or general dispatch/host-default. Viewer mock actions cannot call Tauri invoke by action string.
refresh: Build temporary supported projection from current owner snapshot after explicit refresh request. Revalidate generation/revision/consumer, replace only on success, new preview UUID and sequence1; retire old preview. Failure leaves previous mock projection visibly stale, cannot act until valid refresh.
revocation: Content revision, writer generation, project/document close, navigation/reload/destroy revokes affected preview; mock values discarded. No late response installs against different owner.
materials: No file/network/image loading as mock effect. If immutable content references unresolved material/binding, show inert placeholder and disable dependent action with MissingMaterial/MissingBindingTarget. No fake media substitute or execution.
